span.p:
driver/ · FR-08, FR-09
crash = kill process without shutdown, restart in a new process
scenarios from test-scenarios/recovery, expected vs actual

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
log/ · FR2
in-memory tail + file, single append lock
LSN = monotonic counter or byte offset
force = write + fsync, tracks flushedLSN
failure returns a status, caller must not continue

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
log viewer · FR-03
LSN order, filter by txId, read-only, empty log is fine

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
rollback/ · FR-04 · FR3
walk tx records in reverse LSN order
undo INSERT = delete, UPDATE = restore before, DELETE = re-insert at rid
write a CLR for each undo, then ABORT marker
idempotent: already rolled back, committed or unknown id gives a clear status

span.p:
restart/ · FR-07 · FR5
runs before QP and CCM accept work
